svg.title: Courtyard studio, Los Angeles: floor plan
svg.desc: One room, 14 by 9 metres, with a 6 metre glazed bay opening south onto a walled courtyard with an olive tree. Numbered points mark the review table, material library, pin-up wall, desks, entry and courtyard.

g.text: Summer noon: the canopy shades the whole bay
